name: Vollebak
why: Clothing built around unusual materials — graphene, aerogel, Dyneema — sold as much for the material as the garment.
origin: Founded in London in 2016 by the twin brothers Nick and Steve Tidball.

onething.p: For When All Hell Breaks Loose Jacket

notes.craft: Every Vollebak product page sampled states where the garment was constructed (Romania, Portugal, UK, China, Vietnam) and where the material came from, and several name the mill or material maker (Schoeller, Sesia, Brunello, AlphaTek). The garment factories are never named and nothing is owned, but the process write-ups are unusually specific. Named mills, nothing owned: a 3.

cities: Sold direct, through its own site only

craft_evidence.owned_d: No owned factory, mill or workshop found. About page names only the founders (Nick and Steve Tidball) and partners (SAGA Space Architects, Bang & Olufsen); PDPs say 'Constructed in <country>' with partner factories unnamed.
craft_evidence.countries: Sample of 8 PDPs, 8/8 state a country: Romania 2/8 (Full Metal Jacket, Martian Aerogel Jacket), Portugal 2/8 (100 Year T-Shirt, Graphene T-Shirt), UK 2/8 (Sub Zero Sweater, Underwater Kelp Cardigan), China 1/8 (Indestructible Jeans), Vietnam 1/8 (Planet Earth Suit Pants). Fabric origin also stated per PDP (Switzerland, Italy, Japan, UK, US).
